# NYC Taxi — Top Pickup Zones

```{tags} reference, query-template, nyctaxi
```

> [NYC Taxi](../../nyctaxi.md) benchmark · [all NYC Taxi queries](index.md)

Most popular pickup locations

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
    t.pickup_location_id,
    z.zone,
    z.borough,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count
FROM trips t
LEFT JOIN taxi_zones z ON t.pickup_location_id = z.location_id
WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2019-08-18'
  AND t.pickup_datetime < '2019-09-17'
GROUP BY t.pickup_location_id, z.zone, z.borough
ORDER BY trip_count DESC
LIMIT 20
```
